name: EditorialCard

props.description: The link element the card renders into.
props.name: link

tagline: A whole-card link (gh#1435). `variant="journal"`: an edge-to-edge cover, category, title, two lines of description and a footer with a circled arrow; the link is named by its title (aria-labelledby). `variant="spotlight"`: kicker, title and a line beside a tilted picture. Pass the link element (router Link or `<a href>`) as `link`; the card content is rendered into it. Geometry: `--editorial-journal-*`, `--editorial-spotlight-*`.
usage: DO lay journal cards out with `ResponsiveGrid preset="trio"`.
